def transform(grid):
    from collections import Counter
    H,W=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    vals=Counter(v for r in grid for v in r)
    block=vals.most_common(1)[0][0]
    line=[v for v,c in vals.most_common() if v!=block][0]
    hrows=[r for r in range(H) if all(grid[r][c]!=block for c in range(W))]
    vcols=[c for c in range(W) if all(grid[r][c]!=block for r in range(H))]
    M={(r,c):grid[r][c] for r in hrows for c in vcols
       if grid[r][c] not in (block,line)}
    mr=sorted({r for r,_ in M}); mc=sorted({c for _,c in M})
    nR,nC=len(mr)-1,len(mc)-1
    out=[[block]*nC for _ in range(nR)]
    for i in range(nR):
        for j in range(nC):
            corners=[(mr[i],mc[j]),(mr[i],mc[j+1]),(mr[i+1],mc[j]),(mr[i+1],mc[j+1])]
            cv=[M[k] for k in corners if k in M]
            if len(cv)==4 and len(set(cv))==1: out[i][j]=cv[0]
    return out

# Let me run the task file's algorithm on the training data to see what it produces
# This will help me understand if my marker extraction approach is correct

def run_task_algorithm(grid):
    from collections import Counter
    H, W = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    vals = Counter(v for r in grid for v in r)
    block = vals.most_common(1)[0][0]
    line = [v for v, c in vals.most_common() if v != block][0]
    
    hrows = [r for r in range(H) if all(grid[r][c] != block for c in range(W))]
    vcols = [c for c in range(W) if all(grid[r][c] != block for r in range(H))]
    
    M = {(r, c): grid[r][c] for r in hrows for c in vcols if grid[r][c] not in (block, line)}
    mr = sorted({r for r, _ in M})
    mc = sorted({c for _, c in M})
    
    nR, nC = len(mr) - 1, len(mc) - 1
    out = [[block] * nC for _ in range(nR)]
    
    for i in range(nR):
        for j in range(nC):
            corners = [(mr[i], mc[j]), (mr[i], mc[j+1]), (mr[i+1], mc[j]), (mr[i+1], mc[j+1])]
            cv = [M[k] for k in corners if k in M]
            if len(cv) == 4 and len(set(cv)) == 1:
                out[i][j] = cv[0]
    
    return out

# Apply to training data
print("=== Running task algorithm on Training Examples ===")
for i, te in enumerate(task_data):
    result = run_task_algorithm(te['input'])
    print(f"\nExample {i}: {len(te['input'])}x{len(te['input'][0])} -> {len(result)}x{len(result[0])}")
    print(f"  Original: {te['output'][0]}")
    print(f"  Algorithm: {result[0]}")
    print(f"  Match: {result == te['output']}")
